THE GEOGRAPHY BEHIND THE VIEW

Many beginnings,
connected journeys.

India's rivers do not begin at a single point. Tributaries usually converge downstream. Distributaries split away, particularly in deltas.

Terrain is vertically exaggerated to reveal the mountains and plateaus. Moving lights illustrate downstream direction; they do not represent measured water speed, discharge, flood conditions, or travel time.
